_note: Input list for ingest_ats.py. Adding a board is a one-line edit here, not a code change. Tokens are the public job-board slugs these companies publish so their careers pages can be embedded elsewhere; the endpoints are documented and unauthenticated. Keep `verified` honest: set it true only once a fetch has actually returned jobs.

_date_semantics.lever: createdAt is a true creation timestamp -> eligible for quarterly time bins
_date_semantics.ashby: publishedAt is a true publication timestamp -> eligible for quarterly time bins
_date_semantics.greenhouse: updated_at is LAST-MODIFIED, not creation -> text source only, excluded from time bins

_identity_warning: A live token is not the company you assumed. 'porter' on Lever is a US healthcare staffing firm, not the Indian logistics company -- it returned 26 nurse-practitioner vacancies in Massachusetts and Florida. ALWAYS check sample titles and locations before adding a board, not just that the endpoint returns 200.
